fusions.name: Rim Jab
fusions.desc: A jab with the rim that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You heal for 12% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Hurled Platter
fusions.desc: Hurls a platter that deals 16 blunt damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range, and knocks the target back 3.5 tiles. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Clasped Guard
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 6 health.

fusions.name: Stacked Plates
fusions.desc: When you gain health, you gain a ward that absorbs 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
